--- clean.sv
+++ buggy.sv
@@ -12,7 +12,7 @@
 			begin 
 				match <= 1'b0;
 			end
-		else if (a_tem == 8'b0111_0001)
+		else if (a_tem == 8'b0111_0001 && a_tem[7] == 1'b0)
 			begin
 				match <= 1'b1;
 			end

claims.violated_requirement: The output match should be asserted only when the shift register matches 8'b0111_0001, but the mutant requires an additional condition that the MSB is 0. This will fail when the pattern matches but the MSB is 1.
claims.spec_basis: The specification states that match should be asserted whenever a_tem matches 8'b0111_0001, without additional conditions.

grammar_error: Syntax-token insertion/deletion is forbidden. Replace at most two existing operands/operators, or swap one existing two-operand concatenation. Do not append an if guard.
